subject.title: Add logging and warnings for cron job execution failures

question: Which public cron health/readiness contract should OpenClaw expose for failed, skipped, or overdue cron jobs?
rationale: The logging and CLI warning work is bounded, but the issue explicitly asks for health endpoint behavior and 200/503 semantics that affect operator and deployment contracts.

options.title: Fold Cron Into Existing Probes
options.body: Add cron degradation to the existing health/readiness/RPC model without creating a new component route, keeping the public HTTP surface smaller.

options.title: Add Dedicated Cron Route
options.body: Implement `/health/cron` with explicit cron-only 200/503 behavior, accepting a new HTTP contract for operators.

options.title: Defer Health, Ship Local Observability
options.body: Limit the first change to structured logs and CLI list warnings, leaving endpoint semantics for a later owner-approved design.

recommendation.title: Fold Cron Into Existing Probes
recommendation.body: Add cron degradation to the existing health/readiness/RPC model without creating a new component route, keeping the public HTTP surface smaller.

likelyOwner.reason: He left the detailed prior review context and has recent cross-cutting cron/CLI work, making him the best available routing owner for the product-direction call.
